name: TangoGS
definition: A density controller for 3D Gaussian Splatting that combines a capture-derived learning allowance (model sizing) with training-based adaptation (quality feedback) to automatically scale the number of Gaussians across different capture sizes without retuning.
summary: TangoGS is a density control strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that automatically scales Gaussian primitives to match scene complexity without per-scene tuning.
